It is disheartening that the more recent environments gain less from RC Wraith, despite seeming like places her sleuthing would be valuable.

Phosphorescent Chamber and Pervasive Red Dust are the big winners, Pervasive Red Dust is insanely good for RC Wraith to find, you get to essentially put an equipment card from your hand into play, or discard to put one in your trash into play.  It rules.

posts.name: phantaskippy
posts.cooked:
Regular Nightmist's most effective card is Amulet.

Her base power gves you the exact cost of amulet for 2 damage.  So you get a basic 2 damage now to redirect 3 or more damage later is a win, otherwise you redirect the 2 damage Nightmist deals herself.

Running Amulet Nightmist is all about knowing what amounts of damage are going to come your way in the fight, and saving enough cards to cover big hits, and using the rest to take care of the biggest hits you can, accounting for her own cards as well.

I love DW Nightmist because is removes the repeatable stable cost of cards and makes her a much more interesting character.

I feel like Super Scientific Tachyon basically fires regular Tachyon from play. Either you're going to end up flipping two cards into the discard instead of one with a mismatch or a pair of one-shots, or you'll get the setup cards that Tachyon wants in play ASAP anyway.
